_schedule_comment: WEEKLY WAVES per WEBSITE-GROWTH-TIMING.md: ship batches 1-2 weeks apart (weekly = lower bound of the rule). Each wave is GATED ON GSC: before promoting, confirm the prior wave is indexing (3-14 day window) and has no 'Crawled - not indexed' rows (those suppress crawl of NEW pages domain-wide) — if Wave 1 hasn't started indexing yet, SLIP the next wave a week rather than ship into a stalled domain. Every promoted URL needs >=1 external backlink (Mission Control warns on promote). Geo pages (sacramento/LA/SF-bay) are ON HOLD — not scheduled — until rank map shows >=25-35% top-3 coverage and the 30-URL backlink floor is met; city-list pages are a spam flag since Aug 2025. CODE PAGES FOR FUTURE WAVES live on stacked git branches (wave-5 -> wave-6 -> wave-8 -> wave-9, each containing its predecessors): on a wave's Monday, Mission Control's publish-week action merges `branch` into main, promotes the wave's URLs, and deploys. Merge IN ORDER — branches are stacked, so merging a later wave brings earlier waves' pages too (their URLs stay noindexed until promoted, so it's safe, but order keeps the repo matching the schedule).
